turns.question: On 1 and 2 October 2026, how much larger in EUR was the average amount of returns with reason damaged than of returns with reason wrong size?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no average-return metric, so I can't give that average; for 1 and 2 October 2026 the closest metrics, Returns (EUR) and Returns, give damaged returns 12.50 EUR across 1 return and wrong size returns 5.00 EUR across 1 return.
